messages.subject: Link functions in TMB
parts:
Hi All,

I'm pretty new to TMB and have been trying to build some models. 
I was wondering is there a capacity to declare a link function within TMB based on the the distribution.
E.g in R for a Poisson, Negative binomial, Tweedie using a log link:

link <- make.link("log")
mu <- link$linkinv(eta)

Or do I just need to declare is with a few logical calls as per this C++ code:

if(dat.disty==1){//bernoulli
fits.at( MATREF3D(i,s,g,dat.nObs,dat.nS)) = inverse_logit(eta);
}
if(dat.disty==2 | dat.disty==3 | dat.disty==4 | dat.disty==5){//poisson, ippm, negative binomial, tweedie
fits.at( MATREF3D(i,s,g,dat.nObs,dat.nS)) = exp(eta);
        }
if(dat.disty==6){//normal
fits.at( MATREF3D(i,s,g,dat.nObs,dat.nS)) = eta;
       }

Cheers,

Skip.
